swap4_semantics.input: SWBOTB=5 reads DATE5/HBOT5 and packs numeric dates and prescribed lower-face heads into HBOTAB
swap4_semantics.boundary_owner: HeadCalc solves prescribed bottom face pressure head; qbot is derived output
swap4_semantics.existing_swap5_solver_evidence: src/adapter/mod_reference_richards_legacy_binding.f90 materializes qbot and mass residual for accepted bottom_mode=5 solves

ownership_findings: The backend accepts bottom_mode=5 and explicit bottom_head; the shared Reference solver already applies the fixed-head boundary and computes accepted qbot/mass accounting.
The production bootstrap currently classifies every bottom_mode=5 application as groundwater-owned, requires a valid datum and positive ledger identity, and registers a groundwater participant.
The typed forcing currently has no SWBOTB=5 time table; SWBOTB=2 provides a same-owner precedent for immutable forcing control evaluated from the current substep interval.
A standalone prescribed-head mode therefore requires an explicit ownership discriminator; it must not be inferred by installing a second mutable water-table/state owner.
production_admission: NONE; this census/preregistration is local development authority only and does not supersede canonical admission
